'''Rika/Moab''' was a weapons-manufacturing company that existed during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It specialized in producing weapons for [[Droid/Legends|automata]], such as [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
